description: This agent helps the user to troubleshoot software or hardware issues with their computer with adaptive support integration.

beforeAgentCallbacks.description: Update the `schedule_appointment_instruction` variable once upon entering the Computer Troubleshooting Agent.
Update the `determine_service_context_instruction` variable once upon entering the Computer Troubleshooting Agent.
Sets the flag "enable_fallback_and_reclassification" to disable reclassification only for lightweight steering agent.

afterAgentCallbacks.description: [10-step Limit Handling] Reset LLM steps to 0 at the end of the turn.

beforeModelCallbacks.description: [10-step Limit Handling] Count the LLM steps and prevent the conversation from failing due to reaching 10-step limit by returning a fallback response at 10th step.

Handle DFCX agent transfer (for spanish, agent request menu) or Twilio queue transfer (for extension or live agent). Also hides transfer_to_agent to prevent native transfers and always force tool calls.

Hide tools from the agent when their prerequisite tools are not called or if the tools is not eligible for the current user. Handles the following list of tools (format: Tool: [Prerequisite]):
- set_appointment_date_preference: [non-empty party_ids]
- set_appointment_location_preference: [non-empty party_ids]
- check_appointment_slots: [non-empty party_ids, called set_appointment_date_preference and set_appointment_location_preference]
- create_appointment: [non-empty party_ids, called check_appointment_slots]
- send_appointment_link_sms: [called play_sms_legal_disclosure]
Play SMS disclosures, e.g. "one-time text" offer and "message and data rates may apply" legal disclosure.
Calls the get LMI status tool to check if LMI session was created.

afterModelCallbacks.description: Add a filler response before the slow tool calls.

Transfers to Graceful Signoff Agent when tools set the should_transfer_to_graceful_signoff variable to True. This approach improves transfer reliability over explicit transfer instructions directly in the prompt.

Transfers to Offer Text Agent  when tools set the should_connect_to_offer_text_agent variable to True. This approach improves transfer reliability over explicit transfer instructions directly in the prompt.
